211200.categoryDescription: Trailering from the BLA Australia Edition 15 catalogue.
211200.subCategoryDescription: Trailer Parts & Towing products grouped for AQUAM INSULA Fiji quotation and paid-order fulfilment.
211200.websiteDescription:
An economical, portable 12 volt electric trailer winch that is ideal for the retrieval of small trailer boats. Supplied with a hand-held remote for power-in only operation, as well as a quick release bracket for easy attachment and removal to either the tow ball or winch post. Also Features adjustable free-spooling clutch, galvanised cable and snap hook,emergency crank handle and thermal safety overload. Suitable for intermittent use only i.e. the one to two minutes winching time normally taken to load a boat onto a trailer. Not suitable for industrial or hoisting applications.

211210.description: BLA TRAILER WINCH ELECTRIC 2000LB POWER IN/OUT
211210.categoryDescription: Electrical & Electronics from the BLA Australia Edition 15 catalogue.
211210.subCategoryDescription: Batteries, Charging & Solar products grouped for AQUAM INSULA Fiji quotation and paid-order fulfilment.
211210.websiteDescription:
Economical 12 volt general purpose winch with permanent magnet motor and 1531 planetary gearing. Power-in/power-out operation is via a weather resistant, hard wired hand remote. Free-spooling clutch is operated by a pull and turn knob which disengages the gearbox allowing the cable to be pulled out manually. Galvanised steel cable with snap hook included. Suitable for intermittent duty operation only (such as winching a boat on/off a trailer) and is not suitable for industrial or hoisting applications.
